articles.summary: As a former claims adjuster, I’ve seen my fair share of claims. Yet there’s one claim in particular that I still remember as the most rewarding. The claim I was assigned to was in rural Alabama where a tornado had demolished the entire town. The policyholder was a retired elderly lady who lived alone with her dog. Not knowing how she’d be able to afford the repairs, she was understandably distraught.
